decision: Selected the site location that the Environment Agency's installations register publishes for permit EPR/ZP3128SD (holder Global Infrastructure UK Limited, 'Data Center at Maxwells Farm West, Great Cambridge Road, Cheshunt, EN8 8XH', Broxbourne): latitude 51.695661, longitude -0.047911 (grid reference TL3501301461), copied without transformation, as the locator of Google's Waltham Cross data centre. It replaces the imported Waltham Cross locality point. It is the regulator's single site point for the permitted standby-generation installation, not a building outline or surveyed position.

selected_properties.activities: Combustion; Any Fuel =>50MW - 1.1 A(1) a) (AR1, primary); MCP
selected_properties.address: Data Center at Maxwells Farm West, Great Cambridge Road, Cheshunt, EN8 8XH

transform.note: No transform is applied to the published latitude and longitude. Check only: pyproj 3.7.1 EPSG:27700 -> EPSG:4326 of the register's easting and northing (535013, 201461) gives 51.6956675, -0.0479179, 0.87 m from the published point.

identity_checks.google_staff: EA Compliance Assessment Report ZP3128SD/0577391 (2 September 2025) lists Google site operations, plant engineer, environmental compliance manager and facility manager staff among those met on site (initials only; not copied).
identity_checks.google_engine_regime: EA Compliance Assessment Report ZP3128SD/0607187 (15 September 2026) says 'Google was following the corporate engine test regime'.
identity_checks.town: Google's 16 September 2025 post places the data centre in Waltham Cross, Hertfordshire; Waltham Cross and Cheshunt are both in the Borough of Broxbourne, the register's local authority.
identity_checks.screening: No other Atlas site, project, source-record location, queued change, hold coordinate or claim lies within 2 km of the new point; the only record within 2 km is this site's own old point (1.5 km).

exclusions: The register does not state how its site point was fixed (survey, plan or postcode), and the permit's site plan was not available on the register (no permit documents are published for this registration). No map service, geocoder, postcode lookup or town centroid is used.
